verdict.rationale: Cursor docs explicitly describe 'always-on agents that run on schedules or triggers to build, maintain, and fix your software,' directly matching recurring/scheduled automation workflows. However, this is only first-party marketing copy with no independent/hands-on corroboration or detail on scheduling configuration options. Missing for 10: independent verification of scheduled-agent reliability, documentation depth on trigger/schedule configuration, and community confirmation of real-world use.
